source_version_policy: Fix source_version only from one root-level snapshot or conversion manifest after partition role, reference-set, deletion, and empty-side-table semantics are stated and every works and works_referenced_works row has been read without a timestamp conflict. Partition directory dates are candidates, not snapshot dates.
author_entity_policy: Quarantine authors* tables. Do not read their values or fill raw names and affiliations.
coverage_policy: null until a value scan is actually run; column-statistic availability is not a coverage rate
empty_side_table_policy: A missing side table or a zero-row file is unknown_no_rows, not reported_empty.
